blood culture results showed no growth at 1 week
Hematoxylin-eosin stained sections and CD56 immunostaining showing intravascular atypical cells

concepts.why: Intravascular atypical cells were found on skin biopsy, which is a characteristic feature of intravascular lymphoma.

concepts.preferred_label: Immune-Related Adverse Event (IRAE) due to Pembrolizumab
concepts.why: The patient has a history of pembrolizumab treatment and developed a new skin eruption, which is consistent with an immune-related adverse event.
The patient has a low white blood cell count and low platelet count, which is consistent with pancytopenia.
The patient has a history of chronic pulmonary coccidioidomycosis and is being treated with fluconazole, which suggests that coccidioidomycosis is still an active consideration.
The patient has a low white blood cell count, low hemoglobin level, and low platelet count, which is consistent with severe aplastic anemia.
The patient has a skin eruption with atypical cells on biopsy, which is consistent with cutaneous T-cell lymphoma.
The patient has a low platelet count and abnormal blood culture results, which is consistent with disseminated intravascular coagulation.
The patient has a history of skin eruption and systemic symptoms, which is consistent with systemic lupus erythematosus.
The patient has a low white blood cell count, low hemoglobin level, and low platelet count, which is consistent with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.
The patient has a history of pembrolizumab treatment and developed hematologic toxicity, which is consistent with pembrolizumab-associated hematologic toxicity.

rationales.F04: The presence of widespread, nontender, erythematous patches and thin plaques is more typical of cutaneous lymphoma or IRAE.
rationales.F08: Thrombocytopenia is a common feature of pancytopenia, severe aplastic anemia, and DIC.
rationales.F10: Intravascular atypical cells are characteristic of intravascular lymphoma.
